d: CM On Nitish Setu : nitish setu ke lokarpan karyakram ke dauran mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri ne bihar ke lie kaee aham baten kahin. unhonne ailan kiya ki bihar sarkar jannayak karpuri thakur ke nam par vishvavidyalay sthapit karne ja rahi hai. samrat chaudhri ne bataya ki vaishali ke rajapakar men 1,200 ekar bhumi ka adhigrahan kiya gaya hai, jahan karib ek lakh logon ko rojgar milne vala hai.
